name: Sukumizu no Uta
source:
It's a peaceful seaside town. It's habitual for girls to wear school swimsuits under uniform there. Main character's hearts starts to burn with passion at the sight of swimsuits.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-december-2003-saya-no-uta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
这是一个和平的海滨小镇。女孩们习惯在制服下穿学校泳装。主人公看到泳装后，心中的热情开始燃烧。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-december-2003-saya-no-uta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
